role: Saved-file open/share/delete/rename, URI grants and mutation error handling

scope.application_commit_reviewed: e625ee7 with unrelated in-progress network/runtime fixes in the working tree
scope.method: Read-only static control-flow and Android platform-source review. No code edits, builds, device interaction or test execution.

findings.title: Sharing a saved SAF document queries its provider on the UI thread
findings.evidence: action(item, "share") is invoked by a Compose UI callback and immediately constructs ClipData.newUri(contentResolver, item.name, uri). AOSP newUri calls getMimeTypes, which synchronously calls ContentResolver.getType(uri) and getStreamTypes(uri,"*/*") for content URIs. This occurs before startActivity and outside Dispatchers.IO.
findings.trigger_and_impact: A slow or offline third-party document provider can hold the main thread while the user shares an already-indexed SAF file; the chooser is delayed and prolonged provider stalls can cause an unresponsive UI. This is a static execution-path finding, not a reproduced ANR.
findings.recommendation: Use the already-indexed item.mime to construct ClipData(item.name, arrayOf(item.mime), ClipData.Item(uri)) directly, retaining Intent.EXTRA_STREAM and FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION. Verify the constructed share Intent metadata and permission flag without needing to query a provider.
findings.status: Reported; no changes made by this reviewer.

verified_observations: External file opening and sharing grant read access only; sharing includes both EXTRA_STREAM and ClipData. No broad write grant is passed to the receiving app.

Renaming validates the requested filename before invoking the provider, retains a changed document URI even when subsequent metadata lookup fails, and migrates hidden-history/collection metadata after persisting the new reference. Existing instrumentation source exercises these previously repaired cases.

Provider deletion and index edits run on Dispatchers.IO under the repository mutex. The UI requests explicit confirmation before deleting file contents. Forget Missing separately removes metadata after a fresh confident local-missing check.
The library does not automatically discard saved SAF URIs solely because permissions are revoked or a provider is offline. Missing, permission-required and unavailable states are differentiated.
Offline previews stop playback on lifecycle pause/stop and disposal, and image decoding limits the target dimensions.
limitations: No chooser receiver was launched and no real URI-grant transfer was verified in this review.

The deletion or rename operation in an external provider and the app's private index cannot be one atomic transaction; the existing source explicitly documents the rename index-write failure limitation. No new universal crash-recovery guarantee was inferred.
The official AOSP source confirms the synchronous provider-query mechanism; the precise duration and any actual ANR on a particular document provider remain unmeasured.
Read-only review found one actionable issue in this scope; no second defect was invented to meet a quota.
